latest_release.name: Version 5.2.0
latest_release.body:
- PHPStan: Add dynamic return type extension for `WP_CLI::get_config()` [[#346](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/346)]
- PHPStan: Add rule for `WP_CLI::add_hook()` usage [[#345](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/345)]
- PHPStan: Add dynamic return type extension for `WP_CLI::do_hook()` [[#344](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/344)]
- Behat steps: support file names containing spaces [[#342](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/342)]
- Drop support for PHPUnit Polyfills v1 [[#341](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/341)]
- Fix `WPCliRuncommandDynamicReturnTypeExtension` when passing invalid options [[#339](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/339)]
- Skip server certificate verification for MariaDB test connections [[#338](https://github.com/wp-cli/wp-cli-tests/pull/338)]
